subject: Urban Planning
title: Why Zoning Exists: Health, Safety, Nuisance
description: A short lesson to help you apply Why Zoning Exists: Health, Safety, Nuisance.

hook.text: Before zoning, a tannery could open next to an orphanage. A slaughterhouse could sit beside a school.

buildup.text: Industrial pollution, noise, and waste mixed with residential life. Disease spread through proximity.

discovery.text: Zoning's original purpose was nuisance prevention — keeping genuinely dangerous uses away from homes.

twist.text: Over time, zoning expanded far beyond health. It now controls building size, density, parking, and aesthetics.

climax.text: Critics argue zoning has become a tool for exclusion, not protection. The original purpose is buried under layers.

punchline.text: It started as 'no factories near homes.' It became 'no apartments near houses.'

quiz.question: What was the original purpose of zoning laws?
options: Maximizing property values in residential neighborhoods
Preventing dangerous or noxious uses from harming nearby residents
Ensuring all buildings matched the architectural style of the area
